title: QuickBooks Sync
description: Your QuickBooks books as a one-page, dark-mode finance command center: connect a company and see cash, revenue, and profit with sparklines, thirteen months of income vs expenses, A/R aging, top customers, and the latest invoices — a realistic sample company connects instantly in the sandbox, and a bound Intuit connection makes it real on deploy.

theme.$comment: The command center's dark art direction (the founder's explicit ask) rides as the pack's seed theme: near-black layered ground, white ink for money in. The palette's dark values are the page's pre-AppShell art constants (palette.ts) verbatim so shell chrome and glass cards read as one surface; the shell defaults to top-nav because the page is a single surface with no in-app navigation — its old chrome was a lone topbar.
